stage: Prepared independent cases; source remains unfrozen and no new follow-up tests executed.
scope: Round14 quote or quiet service-request one-message follow-up; actual local signed inbound/client/managed queue and browser assets, synthetic protocols only.

settledContract.outreachCap: ONE total per exact tenant/request across QUOTE+REQUEST. Attempted/uncertain send never refills through replan, purpose change, correction or renewed consent.
settledContract.consent: Recipient initiates current exact purpose/ref from the saved mobile; provider-accepted fixed sent disclosure SID/wording/version/provider date, then distinct exact-purpose/ref YES. No claim that carrier-delivered DLR is mandatory or implied by acceptance.
settledContract.oldProgram: Existing v3 appointment-only registration unchanged. Expanded variant needs explicit owner review/new registration; no silent upgrade or enabled gate.
settledContract.latePermission: Permission after chosen due time => Needs new time, never stale immediate outreach.
settledContract.milestone: Quote invitation/permission follows retained owner quote-sent milestone. Closed requests explicitly reopen; paid/completed job never inferred.

caseGroups.name: Signed recipient/source authority
cases: Wrong account/sender/service/From/To/body/direction/provider date do not retain consent or queue a question.
Second tenant and reused slug/owner incarnation isolated. Current mobile/request/ref required.

caseGroups.name: Exact two-step question and affirmation
cases: QUOTE/REQUEST initiation queues only exact reviewed disclosure and no outreach.
Generic appointment YES/START/model prose/owner phone field/checkbox cannot grant; generic YES stays out of model.
Absent/early/replayed/wrong-purpose/wrong-ref ask or YES refused; late exact provider receipt reconciles without duplicate ask.
Question/reply statuses accepted/delivered/failed/uncertain remain distinct.

caseGroups.name: One consumable request-wide outreach
cases: Concurrent plans and replay produce one journal operation and deterministic queue ID.
Purpose switch/re-consent/new operation/source correction cannot refill an attempted/unknown request.
An unattempted replacement supersedes the old intent without two queued sends.

caseGroups.name: Owner baseline and timing
cases: Quote-sent milestone required; closed request reopen explicit.
Historical reached before quote plan remains valid; new human contact/reply after baseline stops pending outreach.
Consent controls/HELP do not falsely count as answering the inquiry; STOP always suppresses.
Permission after due time requires owner choose new time. Expiry/30day/quiet-hours/current time boundaries enforced.

caseGroups.name: Current program and final dispatch fences
cases: Old v3 mismatch visible with zero follow-up send. Explicit new review retains exact expanded program digest; no auto upgrade.
Hold awaited budget/claim/readiness then change phone/source/owner/sender/program/gate/policy: no newly unauthorized physical POST.
Optional quote URL exact same-business HTTPS and fixed neutral wording; arbitrary promo body/foreign URL not dispatched.

caseGroups.name: Ordinary recovery and outcomes
cases: Save-to-enqueue failure discovered by normal bounded worker with same ID, including older retained plans.
Unknown ask/outreach only reconciles same provider identity; no blind repeat.
STOP/START/reply/cancel/supersession/late DLR and provider errors preserved without false delivered success.
Cancelled workspace retains read-only owner history and suppresses pending outreach.

caseGroups.name: Current desktop/mobile customer job
cases: Existing request dialog previews exact mobile/business/purpose/message/time and real blocker.
Ordinary schedule/return/error/retry/reopen/cancel paths preserve newer edits and current auth generation.
Public widget invitation only after real saved request; quote choice only after milestone. Tap-to-text sends nothing; copy fallback accessible.
Native keyboard, visible focus, fixed-nav hit testing, no overflow; no false paid-job or completed-service claim.

reuse: Existing launch-appointment-consent-qa-check actual signed Twilio/installed SDK-CAS fixture
Existing request-followthrough UI actual handler/assets harness
Existing managed-delivery/managed-sms worker and protocol doubles
